value.answer: Tomorrow's Tuesday. Which Vancouver, though? For Vancouver, BC: cloudy, high around 14°C, with a few showers starting late in the evening and a low of 11°C overnight. Some sites have showers in the morning too, so that part isn't confirmed. For Vancouver, WA: high around 64°F (18°C), mostly cloudy and dry, low around 48°F Tuesday night.
